title: Not what I expected, a lot thinner than pictured.
text: Not what I expected, a lot thinner than pictured.. I honestly bought these because they looked like just normal hangers like the ones you normally buy at the store I looked around and tried to find ones similar to the ones I already own at home you know normal plastic hangers nothing too fancy but enough to hold my clothes. I was expecting them to at least be well what I saw on the picture, what I got was very poor quality hangers and by that I don't mean like they are not what they look like because they kinda look like that on the picture but the plastic they are made out of seems to be super thin and easy to break, they are also considerably thinner than the ones in my closet (that are simple white plastic hangers exactly like these ones) of course those may be a different brand (I'm not even sure because I could have bought the same ones before I don't know for sure) but these new ones are just bad quality, I guess we'll have to see but the ones I already had are a lot thicker and they have already broken once or twice so I don't expect these ones to hold out either and much less than the other ones since they are ultra thin! I don't know what else to say just probably not worth your money if you are looking for something that will actually hold up your clothes and can carry the weight/ won't bend or break.
